journeys.description: Tap a pin shared by multiple Collection Entries → opens the LocationSheet listing all entries at that pin.
Tap a pin owned by exactly one Collection Entry → opens the EntrySheet for that entry.
Tap the Collections button in the MapOverview chrome → CollectionList.
Long-press the map to drop a pin → LocationDraftSheet with nearby resolution candidates.
Pick a search result from the search affordance → LocationDraftSheet rendering that result.
Tap the Settings affordance → Settings surface.
In addToCollection mode, dismiss the status bar → return to CollectionDetail. Mode-only journey: meaningful only when MapOverview carries a collection-context.

User intent: drop a pin, add it to a Collection, then end up reviewing it. Authored to match the user mental model — DROP_PIN → ADD_TO_COLLECTION → PICK_COLLECTION → return to MapOverview with a temp-bar 'go to review' affordance → ReviewForm. The intermediate MapOverview detour is the intended UX and is the divergence this journey exists to surface.

notes.4: intended: PICK_COLLECTION should return to MapOverview with a transient 'go to review' status bar, not jump straight to ReviewForm.
notes.5: intended: tap the temp 'go to review' bar on MapOverview.

journeys.description: From the map, drill into a Collection, open one of its Entries, edit the review, submit, land back on the Entry detail with the review now saved.
